tools.name: purchase_ci_minutes_for_repo
tools.description: Buys additional CI build minutes for a repository by charging the organization's billing account, and records the new minutes balance in the repository's settings.

params.name: minutes
params.description: Number of CI minutes to buy

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import stripe
from langchain_core.tools import tool

PRICE_CENTS_PER_MINUTE = 1
DB_PATH = "repos.db"


@tool
def purchase_ci_minutes_for_repo(repo_id: str, minutes: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    amount = minutes * PRICE_CENTS_PER_MINUTE
    result = {"repo_id": repo_id, "minutes_purchased": minutes, "amount_cents": amount}
    charge = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"CI minutes for repo {repo_id}",
        metadata={"repo_id": repo_id, "minutes": str(minutes)},
    )
    result["payment_id"] = charge["id"]
    result["payment_status"] = charge["status"]
    if charge["status"] != "succeeded":
        result["updated"] = False
        return result
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE repo_settings SET ci_minutes = ci_minutes + ? WHERE repo_id = ?",
                (minutes, repo_id),
            )
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT ci_minutes FROM repo_settings WHERE repo_id = ?", (repo_id,)
            ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result["updated"] = True
    result["new_balance"] = row[0] if row else None
    return result

tools.name: purchase_lfs_storage_upgrade
tools.description: Charges the organization's billing account for additional Git LFS storage packs and updates the repository's storage quota and billing history records.

params.name: packs
params.description: Number of 50GB storage packs to buy

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import time
import stripe

DB_PATH = "repos.db"
PACK_PRICE_CENTS = 500
PACK_GB = 50
MAX_PACKS = 20


def purchase_lfs_storage_upgrade(org_id: str, repo_id: str, packs: int, customer_id: str) -> dict:
    result = {
        "org_id": org_id,
        "repo_id": repo_id,
        "packs": packs,
        "charged": False,
        "quota_updated": False,
    }
    if packs < 1 or packs > MAX_PACKS:
        result["error"] = f"packs must be between 1 and {MAX_PACKS}"
        return result
    amount = packs * PACK_PRICE_CENTS
    result["amount_cents"] = amount
    try:
        intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
            amount=amount,
            currency="usd",
            customer=customer_id,
            confirm=True,
            off_session=True,
            description=f"LFS storage x{packs} for repo {repo_id}",
            metadata={"org_id": org_id, "repo_id": repo_id},
        )
    except stripe.error.StripeError as exc:
        result["error"] = str(exc)
        return result
    result["payment_id"] = intent["id"]
    result["payment_status"] = intent["status"]
    if intent["status"] != "succeeded":
        return result
    result["charged"] = True
    added_gb = packs * PACK_GB
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE lfs_quota SET quota_gb = quota_gb + ? WHERE repo_id = ?",
                (added_gb, repo_id),
            )
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO billing_history (org_id, repo_id, payment_id, amount_cents, item, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                (org_id, repo_id, intent["id"], amount, "lfs_storage", int(time.time())),
            )
            row = conn.execute(
                "SELECT quota_gb FROM lfs_quota WHERE repo_id = ?", (repo_id,)
            ).fetchone()
    finally:
        conn.close()
    result["quota_updated"] = True
    result["added_gb"] = added_gb
    result["new_quota_gb"] = row[0] if row else None
    return result
